messages.text: Handed to the team · Pool-side fix needed: send real work on a new worker's first job, plus the earli

Hey,

I opened your screenshot. It's the miner's DNS log from 08:56 this morning. The miner looks up us-east.harlolabs.com and gets the IPv4 address 18.204.252.60. It then asks for an IPv6 address, and 8.8.8.8 replies that there isn't one (the NODATA-IPv6 line). That's normal and harmless: the pool has no IPv6 address, so the miner just connects over IPv4.

So the address lookup is working and isn't the problem. It points back to the same pool-side fault as before. The miner finds and reaches the pool, but the first job a new worker gets is the placeholder one, and Braiins OS restarts instead of mining it. Nothing on your side will fix that.

I've sent this log to JD along with your earlier details: Braiins OS 26.10, worker Solo45.S19KPro, and the placeholder job (nbits 1d00ffff, diff 512). The request for a rental port with an extranonce2 size of 7 or more is with him too. Someone on the team will pick it up and reply here with an answer. I can't give you a time for the fix. If you'd like to ask JD directly, he's @nullhashrate in the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf.

Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
Handed to the team · Pool vardiff tuning needed on port 3333. He asks for a grace window that accepts

Hey,

Good news that the S19K Pro is mining on port 3333. I opened your screenshot. It shows stratum+tcp://us-east.harlolabs.com:3333 as Alive and Active for solo45.s19kpro, with 921 accepted, 401 rejected, 0 stale, a last difficulty of 119,698 and a best share of 144,897,040.

Your diagnosis fits those numbers. Zero stale means the rejects aren't coming from job changes. They're shares the miner found at the old difficulty that arrive just after the pool has raised the target. 401 out of 1,322 is about 30 percent by count. Your 49 percent figure by work makes sense too, because the rejected shares tend to be the ones sent around the higher targets. When the difficulty swings 4x in both directions every minute, there's always some work in flight at the old target.

One reassuring point: these rejects can't cost you a block. A share good enough to solve a BCH block is far above 213,056, so it would pass any share target the pool sets. What you lose is share credit, not your block chance.

I don't think anything on your miner will fix this. Lowering the starting difficulty and switching to adjustable both made it worse, which points to the pool's retarget settings and not your configuration. Your two suggestions are the standard fixes: a short grace window that still accepts shares at the previous difficulty after a change, and a smaller step (2x at most) with less frequent retargets. I've sent JD your numbers, the screenshot details and both suggestions. They're logged separately from the port 8888 placeholder job and the rental extranonce2 request, which are still with him. Someone on the team will pick it up and reply here with an answer. I can't promise a change or a time. If you'd like to raise it with JD directly, he's @nullhashrate in the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf.

Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support

Hey,

Thanks for confirming. JD has everything for the port 3333 vardiff problem: the swings between 53,264 and 213,056 about every minute, the low-difficulty rejects after each raise with zero stale, and your two suggestions (a grace window at the previous difficulty, or smaller and less frequent steps). You don't need to send anything else.

Someone on the team will reply in this thread. If anything changes before then, for example the reject rate or the difficulty settling down, send me a screenshot here.

Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support

Hey,

I opened all three screenshots, and the numbers back you up. Two of them are the same cap····, showing 2,079 accepted and 1,173 rejected at a last difficulty of 152,788. The newest one shows 2,123 accepted and 1,207 rejected at 35,202. Stale is still 0 in all of them.

Here's how it's getting worse. Earlier today you were at about 30 percent rejected by count, and now it's 36 percent. Between your two latest cap····, 34 of 78 new shares were rejected, about 44 percent. The difficulty has also dropped to 35,202, below the 53,264 floor it was bouncing off before, so the swings are getting wider rather than settling.

Your backup pool line on the same miner points to the same cause. It shows 564 accepted and 0 rejected at a steady 242,040. Your S19K Pro and Braiins OS are handling shares fine. The rejects come from how port 3333 retargets.

I've sent JD these new figures and flagged that it's getting worse. Your earlier report and suggested fixes are already with him. Someone on the team will reply in this thread. I can't give you a time for the fix. If the rejects are costing you more than you want to carry until then, you could make your backup pool the active one for now. That's your call, and nothing on your miner needs changing either way. To ask JD directly, he's @nullhashrate in the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf.

Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
